messages:
emily: FYI customer ZenithLabs flagged invoice INV-2026-0821 with a duplicated reserved capacity charge across two lines for the same zone and hour. Looks like primary+standby both billed.
marco: can you paste the two invoice lines?
emily: pasted: 
```
line_id, nodepool, zone, hour_start, hour_end, gpu_h, unit_rate
LN-44501, np-eu-2, eu-west-2, 2026-04-21T14:00Z, 2026-04-21T15:00Z, 6.0, 2.50
LN-44502, np-eu-2-standby, eu-west-2, 2026-04-21T14:00Z, 2026-04-21T15:00Z, 6.0, 2.50
```
billing-bot: Meter export available at s3://redwood-exports/zenith/2026-04/meter-0421.csv (md5: d4f9a).
priya: ops note 1: there was a scheduled rolling maintenance in eu-west-2 at 14:08 UTC; standby was promoted while primary drained. The metering job sampled at hour granularity and emitted both entries for that hour.
marco: quick calc: duplicate = 6 gpu-hours * $2.50 = $15.00. Customer charged twice => $30.00 shows on invoice.
tom: policy check 1: our billing policy says we should not charge for overlapping capacity when it's a protective standby spun for HA within same reserved pool. We usually credit duplicates under $100 without escalation.
emily: propose issuing a customer credit CR-2026-210 for $15.00 and opening a short vendor inquiry to see if partner metering can be improved. Approve?
priya: approve. Also suggest we adjust metering to prefer canonical nodepool_id (strip '-standby') when timestamp overlap < 5 minutes after promotion.
marco: finance: can you post GL code and confirm we can apply transient credit now?
tom: GL: BILLING_CREDITS_MISC. Finance ok to absorb temporarily; we will seek partner recovery.
emily: applied CR-2026-210 and attached note to INV-2026-0821. Filed partner ticket VND-4507 with host logs.
marco: I'll reply to customer: short note + credit ETA 2 business days. Keep wording: "we found duplicate metering from a promotion during maintenance; we applied a $15.00 credit and are investigating with our partner."
emily: sent. Customer replied: thanks for the fast fix; asked if we will prevent recurrence.
priya: working on a small metering dedupe that will normalize nodepool names and collapse overlaps under a minute. PR targeted today.
emily: thanks. Closing loop: credit issued, partner ticket open, eng mitigation in flight. Will update FIN ticket FIN-2026-289 when vendor responds. :white_check_mark:
